question: Compare the positions of the first dark fringe and first bright fringe on the same side of the central maximum in Young's double-slit experiment.

options.A: For the first dark fringe, $\Delta x=\dfrac{\lambda}{2}$, hence $x_D=\dfrac{\lambda D}{2d}$. For the first bright fringe, $\Delta x=\lambda$, hence $x_B=\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$. Therefore $x_D=\dfrac{x_B}{2}$; it lies halfway between the central and first bright fringes.
options.B: The first dark and first bright fringes occur at the same position: $x_D=x_B=\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$.
options.C: The first dark fringe is twice as far as the first bright fringe: $x_D=2x_B$.
options.D: The first dark fringe occurs at $x_D=\dfrac{\lambda D}{d}$, while the first bright fringe is at $x_B=\dfrac{\lambda D}{2d}$.
